item.title: Beyond Reason
item.description: Valentine’s Day didn’t begin as a celebration of your loved one. February 14 started out as a church feast day honoring Saint Valentine, which was not especially romantic. The turn comes in the Middle Ages, when poets like Geoffrey Chaucer began linking the day to choosing a mate rather than simply being assigned one.
